dialogues.speaker: Arapacati
dialogues.text: #Nara Varuna looked so happy, so joyful, when talking about {M#brothers}{F#sisters}. Nara are weird. Why are "brothers" and "sisters" so special?

dialogues.speaker: Arapacati
dialogues.text: We later decided, we should be "brothers" and "sisters," to make everyone happy and joyful.

dialogues.speaker: Arapacati
dialogues.text: At first, Arapacati was "brother." But the "sister" back then is gone now. Before being Vasara Tree, he decided that Arapacati should be "sister."
